name: Celtic Camping & Bunkhouses
accommodation: Camping pitches plus bunkhouse and group accommodation across several buildings
beachAccess: Not stated; about four miles north of St Davids with direct access to the coast path
confirmedFeatures: Electric hook-ups, bunkhouse and group accommodation, direct coast path access
overview: Celtic Camping sits by the sea about four miles north of St Davids, with direct access to the Pembrokeshire Coast Path. It offers camping from April to September alongside bunkhouses and group accommodation, making it a practical option for larger parties heading to Whitesands and the north-coast beaches.
surfTripFit: The bunkhouses suit group surf trips on a budget, with Whitesands a short drive away.
